test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Going by the current pace of work, I _______ think this will finish by Sunday.
solution: The correct answer is '**don't**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate answer for the given blank is '**don't**'. • We know that after the '**I**' **pronoun** '**do**' is used. • In the later part of the sentence, the **future tense** has already been used. • Hence, all the other options will be incorrect except **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Going by the current pace of work, I **don't** think this will finish by Sunday.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर '**don't**' है। • हम जानते हैं कि '**I**' सर्वनाम के बाद '**do**' का प्रयोग होता है। • वाक्य के बाद के भाग में,** future tense** पहले ही उपयोग किया जा चुका है। • इसलिए, **विकल्प 2 **को छोड़कर अन्य सभी विकल्प गलत होंगे। 40:Tc0d, The correct answer is '**strict**'.
